rules.statement: Acquire Gingerscope by intelligent trading; protect and keep building inventory after acquisition.
Never select or offer Gingerscope outbound; treat it as permanently protected inventory.
Do not restore the obsolete blanket +15-value profit requirement.
Do not force a highest-valued weapon to open every trade.
User canceled automated chat negotiation; do not implement it without a new explicit request.
Fully automatic trading is a future product goal, never evidence of current authorization.
Never infer server-authenticated settlement from client callbacks, GUI changes, LastOffer or inventory deltas.
Automatic final Accept, completed profit and Discord completion notices remain unauthorized without separate proofs.
Future manual iPad tests require in-game numbered safe-geometry prompts, not overlaying the TradeGUI.
Preserve verified Part3 and Part4 work and independently test any proposed changes before deployment.
Do not repeat closed Stage119, Stage101 or prior iPad tests absent a separately justified new issue.
Expired Supreme data cannot be promoted to current market prices by redownloading or restamping.
Solve and test one distinct blocker at a time; preserve failed historical attempts and evidence links.
Never commit Discord records, trade identifiers, private usernames or sensitive runtime logs to public GitHub.
